notes: Summary: Lost to OpenAI direct API for primary chat embeddings pipeline. Decision driven by perceived simplicity + brand trust; engineering wanted a plug-and-play route.
Sales path: started as pilot (Nov 2025). Multi-team POC: Customer Success + Search infra + Security. Scope: replace existing vendor for product recs and in-app help chat.
POC results: latency ok on Redwood hosted config; embeddings quality comparable. Cost modeling: Redwood came in slightly higher for token-heavy usage after egress assumptions.
Quote from Head of ML (call 2026-02-10): 'We need the simplest integration. Our roadmap can't absorb a multi-service migration — OpenAI gets us 90% of the wins now.'
Security: SSO/SAML and audit logs were table stakes. Redwood met SOC2 checklist; customer worried about vendor lock and wanted vendor name recognition for exec signoff.
Procurement: legal asked for vendor references and pricing concession. They requested a 12-month commitment discount; finance hit freeze on new enterprise commitments in Jan 2026.
Champion situation: initial champion (Sr. ML Eng) changed teams in Dec 2025. No secondary exec sponsor surfaced — major risk that never recovered.
Competitive dynamics: procurement ran a 2-week spike eval of OpenAI/Anthropic; OpenAI path required less infra work and had stronger internal brand cache for L4 approval.
Triage notes: SE ran two deep-dive sessions on batching, quantization options; they liked Redwood's cost controls but preferred the direct vendor simplicity.
Post-loss ask: permission to keep nightly security newsletters and alert them on any FedRAMP/ISO/PS updates. Offer: re-run TCO in 6 months if budget unfreezes.
Internal: deal moved to closed-lost 02/18/2026. Capture: loss_code=competitor_simplicity_brand. Follow-up owner: AE to send short post-mortem and log lessons in Gong/Deal review.
